text.p: G&K Services Inc said Tuesday that Steve LaBelle, secretary and treasurer, recently resigned from the company, effective this month.
A search is being conducted to fill this position, G&K said.
No reason was given for LaBelle's resignation. No one was available at the company for further comment.
Earlier, G&K reported fiscal second quarter results of $0.35 a share, up from $0.27 a year ago.

"Uniform rental operations continue to show healthy growth," Richard Fink, chairman, said in a statement. "Although the second quarter revenue rate increase of 14.8 percent was down slightly from the year earlier period, new account sales and account retention rates remainded high."

For the second quarter, rental operations revenue rose to $83.6 million from $72.8 million. Direct sales for the quarter were $3.9 million, up from $2.3 million a year ago. Total revenues for the quarter were $87.4 million, up from $75.1 million for the year-ago quarter.
Fink said rental operating margins continued to improve, reaching 15.2 percent in the quarter compared with 14.8 percent last year.
